value.rationale: Theorem 2.1 and Corollary 2.2 are the article's foundational equivalence used to pass between ordinary and controlled continuous g-frames. The failure appears in the smallest nontrivial real dimension and makes the defining energy negative, so it is a structural breakdown rather than a nonoptimal constant. The exact repair identifies the missing positive mixed operator and gives a simple commutative sufficient hypothesis.
